aiSection.title: Let AI handle inquiries while you focus on what matters
aiSection.subtitle: Not a gimmick — fewer missed messages, fewer lost clients
aiSection.item1Desc: Clients ask about pricing or availability after hours, on weekends, late at night — and most businesses don't reply until the next day. By then, they've already messaged someone else. AI responds instantly, answers common questions, gives ballpark pricing, and guides clients toward booking — so no inquiry goes to waste while you're offline.
aiSection.item2Desc: Inquiries from LINE, forms, and Instagram are scattered everywhere and easy to miss. The system pulls everything into one place automatically — sorted by service type, intent level, and whether they're new or returning clients. No more relying on memory to keep track of who asked what.
aiSection.item3Desc: Most inquiries go cold not because clients changed their minds, but because follow-up was slow or never happened. AI automatically follows up after an inquiry, reminds clients who didn't complete a booking, and keeps warm leads from slipping away — so more of the people who reach out actually end up paying.
aiSection.item4Desc: Real estate agents writing outreach letters, sales reps filling in quotes, consultants drafting proposals — same structure every time, just different details. Enter the client's basic info and AI produces a complete, professional document in seconds. Spend your time on the conversations that matter, not on copy-pasting.
aiSection.note: AI automation is an optional add-on — available with any plan

whyMe.title: What typically happens after launch
whyMe.case1Problem: Spending time every day scheduling via messaging apps — still replying to clients after hours, missing bookings in the process
whyMe.case1Result: Clients pick their own time slot and get automatic reminders — bookings come in even when you’re offline, no-shows drop noticeably
whyMe.case2Problem: The website launched, but new clients still come through referrals only. Google doesn’t surface it, and the site just sits there looking nice
whyMe.case2Result: With SEO adjustments and result-focused copy, the site starts generating inbound inquiries from search — not just a digital business card
whyMe.case3Problem: After launch, no one to call when something breaks. Changes take weeks, or you end up figuring it out yourself
whyMe.case3Result: Ongoing maintenance partnership with a dedicated contact. No technical knowledge required — just send a message and it gets handled

pricingPage.title: Let Your Website Work for You — Automated Inquiries, Bookings, and More
pricingPage.subtitle: Traffic, decent design, but still not enough inquiries — the problem usually isn't how it looks, it's conversion. Every plan below is built with that in mind.
pricingPage.annualNote: Billed annually — equivalent to 2 months free
pricingPage.customNote: Not sure which to choose? The Starter site focuses on brand presence; the Booking site focuses on your intake flow — if you take appointments, go with that. All prices are base estimates, feel free to chat first.
pricingPage.subscriptionNote: Subscription plans assume you already have a website. If not, start with a one-time plan first.

pricingPage.pain1Title: Scheduling through messaging apps all day
pricingPage.pain1Desc: Clients ask 'when are you free?' — you check your calendar, reply, confirm, remind. Time gone.
pricingPage.pain2Desc: When someone asks 'do you have a website?' and you send an IG link — you've already lost half the credibility.

pricingPage.proof3Desc: Time spent manually managing orders and members gets back to you. One dashboard instead of checking five chat groups.

pricingPage.faq1q: Is there really no upfront cost for subscription plans?
pricingPage.faq1a: Correct. Subscription plans require no deposit. We start building your site right after signing, and you pay a fixed monthly fee.
pricingPage.faq2q: Can I cancel after the minimum contract?
pricingPage.faq2a: Yes. After the 6-month minimum, the plan converts to month-to-month. Give one month's notice anytime to cancel.
pricingPage.faq3q: Does the one-time plan include hosting?
pricingPage.faq3a: No, hosting is billed separately at around NT$1,000/month (includes server, SSL, and daily backups). Alternatively, subscription plans bundle everything together so you never have to manage technical settings yourself.
pricingPage.faq4a: During the subscription period, the site is hosted and managed by Golden Mountain. If you ever cancel, we can transfer the source code to you or convert to a one-time plan to give you full ownership.
